g.text: A Tag Names a Handler — One MeTTaIL Mechanism at Two Levels
A conventional namespace can be squatted; a
the definition fingerprint cannot. Cross-language matching therefore
: a mismatch is a *non*-firing, never a *wrong* firing.
Where the two levels differ, honestly.
Level 1 interprets *source text*, so it is a
reader-level construct and inherits the modal-lexer delimiter obligations. Level 2
interprets *values*, so it needs no lexer at all. The shared content is the resolution
keyed by an unforgeable identity — not the syntax.
FLT — a tag over guest source
Spec notation — a tag over a Rholang value
